verdict.rationale: The Division publishes its own step-by-step videos for filing registrations, certifications, apostilles and setting up a PBS account. It also has a 'getting registered' page that sequences filings toward a Business Registration Certificate, and its task descriptions are written in plain language, such as 'When you have already formed/authorized your business in NJ and need to register for tax and employer purposes'. Even form numbers like CD-100 and CD-101 come with plain explanations of when to use each. Missing for 10: evidence of in-depth written explainers beyond videos and one-line task descriptions, coverage of founder tasks beyond the listed ones (e.g., choosing an entity type), and independent or hands-on corroboration that a non-lawyer can follow the guidance.
